notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.notes:
A critical issue has been fixed with non-english Windows systems.

When launching the game, a folder is created in "My Documents" and apparently the translation of the folder's name prevented the files to be created.

This has been fixed. The game now creates the proper files to the "Saved Games" folder.

/!\ IMPORTANT /!\ : Steam Cloud has been updated with that setting, so if you wish to keep your progress and highscore, please go to "My Documents", cut the "ROGUS - Kingdom of The Lost Souls" folder and paste it in your "Saved games" folder, usually located under "C:\users\"YourProfile"\"

The person responsible for that mistake has been whipped in public place.

notes.title: Steam Release & 1.2 Update!
notes.notes:
In a dark office, deep under the surface, a man that we will call Steve, employee of some shady U.S. government administration arrives at work like any other day. And like any other day Steve wonders if he should push the F5 button on his keyboard. It is his job and only task: To arrive at work and hit F5 once during the day, then go home. But Steve hates his life when he's home so he spends much of his time at work NOT pushing the F5 button. He doesn't know what it does and doesn't really care. It probably updates some random database and sends an automatic letter to a few people, who knows. Steve hasn't pushed the button for a few months now, and today "This is the right day" he thinks to himself...
And Steve pushed the button again.

The wait is now over.
[...]

As mentioned by someone in a discussion: It has been months, indeed, and you would not believe how frustrated I have been for not being able to publish the game to Steam.

ROGUS is finally here and it has been updated : 

Changelog version 1.2
- Fixed some rare issue where the player would get stuck in the stairs
- Fixed issue with Lady dialogs not registering properly
- Fixed issue with teleportation stone
- Fixed a spell parameter not resetting correctly
- Fixed incompatibility with Steam Overlay

- Added 20 Steam Achievements! (It took me an unthinkable amount of time to make these 20 achievement pictures so YOU BETTER UNLOCK 'EM ALL!  :)
